stories.title: Heatwave warning as older people in North Wales face deadly dehydration risk in soaring temperatures
stories.summary: A social care leader has issued a warning as soaring temperatures put older and vulnerable people in North Wales at increased risk during the heatwave. stories.title: Welsh dairy farms running below cost of production, union warns
stories.summary: Flintshire farmers are among those across Wales being hit by rising fertiliser and fuel costs, with the Farmers’ Union of Wales warning of mounting financial strain in the dairy sector. stories.title: Murder investigation launched following death on Barmouth beach yesterday
stories.summary: A murder investigation has been launched following the death of a 34-year-old man in Barmouth yesterday. Detectives are now appealing for witnesses to come forward. stories.title: Festival to celebrate 300th anniversary of overlooked Welsh naturalist who inspired Charles Darwin
stories.summary: A festival is being held to celebrate 300 years since the birth of overlooked Welsh naturalist Thomas Pennant, who is said to have inspired Charles Darwin. stories.title: Met Office to inspect Hawarden weather station after provisional Wales record
stories.summary: A weather station at Hawarden Airport recorded 32.2C on Monday 25 May, a provisional new all-time May temperature record for Wales.
